text:
maria: Hey team — opened a tiny PR to refresh the starter app quickstart. Fixes: auth env var names, adds Node SDK snippet, and corrects the deploy command for Dedicated. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427

jon: I'll review the auth part. Which env vars changed? don't want to break folks on upgrade.

maria: Previously used REDWOOD_API_KEY; new recommended var is INFERENCE_API_KEY (we also mention key scopes). Kept REDWOOD_API_KEY in a migration note.

kevin: Quick glance: the Node SDK snippet uses `client.createCompletion` but v2 is `client.generate`. We should update the example so it's not misleading.

maria: good call — swapping now. New snippet: 
```js
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood(process.env.INFERENCE_API_KEY);
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-alpha', prompt: 'Hello world' });
console.log(res.output);
```

ash: Also the deploy command still shows `rw deploy --prod`. For Dedicated we prefer `rw deploy --target=dedicated --region=us-west-2`. Please add a short note about account mapping and capacity tiers.

jon: I'll add a one-line migration note for existing customers and link to the old quickstart for reference.

maria: CI flagged a broken link at line 42: points to /old-quickstart — should change to /quickstart/starter-app. Can someone patch that before merge?

docs-bot: PR #1427 — checks passed ✅, deploy preview: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/1427

kevin: pushed a tiny follow-up commit to the branch to change `createCompletion` -> `generate` and adjust the response shape. maria can you confirm the example response matches SDK output?

maria: Verified locally. Updated example response to `{ output: string, tokens: number }` and added a one-line note about token billing in quickstart costs.

ash: One more micro-ask: include a 1-sentence callout about batching in the quickstart (saves cost for bursty requests). Makes the Optimize cross-link more discoverable.

jon: LGTM from my side. @maria feel free to merge once the link is fixed.

maria: Fixed the link, merged. Thanks all :party_parrot:
